ionized_plasma.rationale: Published EHT development models describe hot ionized emitting plasma; T_e is 1e10--1.2e11 K.

MAD_reconnection.rationale: MAD is supported as a viable/favored GRMHD model family by EHT polarimetric comparisons; reconnection timescale itself remains unresolved.

pair_relevant.rationale: T_e can exceed m_e c^2/k_B, but compactness, pair balance and source size are not frozen; pair dominance cannot be inferred from temperature alone.

electron_degenerate.rationale: Minimum kT/E_F over the sourced n_e,T_e box is 5.091e+15 >> 1.

electron_capture.rationale: Composition, ion temperature and weak-interaction rate network are not frozen; thermal electron energy alone is insufficient to promote this channel.

nuclear_network.rationale: No source-bound ion composition/temperature or nuclear reaction network has been frozen.

pycnonuclear.rationale: Pure-H density proxy upper bound is 1.673e-17 g/cm^3; reference pycnonuclear crust scale is ~1e12 g/cm^3, a gap >= 5.979e+28.

spin_Landau_QED.rationale: max chi_spin=2.015e-13, max chi_L=4.030e-13, max B/B_Q=6.797e-13; all are far below unity.

preservation_rule: Executed domain-admissibility evidence only; G4-G7 and SGPT validation remain unresolved.
